Retrieves the array of command strings for this action.

## Signature

```typescript
get commands(): string[];
```

## Remarks

The action must be initialised via [Action.initialise()](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/action/initialise) before accessing this property. Attempting to access commands from an uninitialised action will result in an assertion error.
